# MIFECO Consulting ROI Calculator
## For use in $199 Strategy Sessions and Retainer Proposals

---

## What This Is

A framework for quantifying the return on investment of AI consulting engagements. Use during the $199 strategy session to anchor the value conversation, or when proposing a custom retainer or implementation project.

**Core formula:**
```
Annual ROI = (Annual Savings / Cost of Engagement) × 100
Payback Period (months) = Cost of Engagement / Monthly Savings
```
